title: Dashboard Chronicle tab shows which writer produced each Eva entry
goal: Each Eva entry shows its writer: the model, or the template when the model was unavailable or its text failed the check
acceptance: A failing test (committed first) over the chronicle data the dashboard reads: an Eva entry carries writer and language; the Simple entry carries none

The Chronicle tab shows a small quiet label per Eva entry (model name, or template with the reason in a few words) using existing tokens, with no new colour; read docs/STYLE-GUIDE.md first; the Simple entries look as today
If the tab has moved to Angular by then (F-130), the label lands in the registered component instead of dashboard.js
privacy: Neutral invented bases, pilots, sorties and days only; no owner data, tokens or real conversation text in Git, tests or logs.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A visible change in how a section looks or behaves goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one field and one label in an existing renderer. Not a measurement.
